item.title: 20-Minute Low Calorie Salmon & Roasted Veggies
item.description: Craving a fast, healthy dinner? Try this easy sheet pan salmon and roasted veggie recipe! Ready in just 20 minutes, packed with protein, and super low calorie. ~420 Calories & 35g Protein. Ingredients: salmon fillet, broccoli, bell peppers, olive oil, lemon, garlic. Prep: Toss veggies with oil and seasonings, place salmon on the pan, and roast at 400°F for 15 mins. #HealthyDinner #WeightLossMeals #SalmonRecipe #HealthyRecipes #CleanEating
